name: DeMeco Ryans' Wide-9 Attack & Match Coverage
description: An aggressive, downhill defensive system engineered around pure physical dominance and geometric leverage. Features extreme Wide-9 defensive end alignments and Tackle-Wrap stunt games that crush pass protections with 4 rushers, backed by split-field Cover 2 Palms (2-Read) cloud traps, Cover 1 Low-Hole mug looks, and field-overload 5-man fire zones.
